About the Practice

Samaritan Hospital, part of St. Peter's Health Partners, is a community hospital offering a wide range of inpatient and outpatient services. These include emergency services, critical care, ambulatory surgery, cancer services, behavioral health services, and cardiac catheterization. The hospital also features specialized nursing care in areas such as ICU/CCU, PCU, Oncology, and the Emergency Department, and operates a hospitalist program to supervise and coordinate patient care during hospital stays. Primary Electronic Health Record System

Research Analysis
Methodology & Findings

Samaritan Medical Center, as part of St. Peter's Health Partners (sphp.com), utilizes the MyHealth patient portal, which has transitioned to Trinity Health MyChart since May 8, 2021. MyChart is the patient portal system commonly associated with the Epic electronic health record (EHR) system. Therefore, Samaritan Medical Center (sphp.com) is likely using Epic as their EHR vendor.
